card.name: Inside contractile and coagulation words
card.fires_on: The ending of long medical words, mainly "ile" in "contractile" and "ulation" in "coagulation", in drug-label text about heart force or clotting tests.

modes.label: contractile
modes.description: The "ile" ending of contractile, before function or force.

modes.description: The "ulation" ending of coagulation before tests or indices.
modes.example: Closely monitor coag<<ulation>> tests to permit appropriate and timely dosage adjustments

card.plain: It fires on the last piece of words like contractile and coagulation when they are being spelled out.
